title: Decompose mediation into placeable, composable capabilities
requirements:
- Decompose interoperability/mediation into capabilities (routing, transformation, discovery, audit, trust)
- Explain that gateways, buses, access points and pub-sub are different dimensions that can be combined
- Describe the interoperability capability as standards, profiles, governance, trust and exchange mechanisms rather than a procured mediator
- Add the point to the DPI-H principles in 1.4
- State each may be realised at endpoints, gateways or shared services, resolving the 'at the endpoints' contradiction
- Rework or annotate Figure 3.6 accordingly
- State its consequence: interoperability needs sustained funding rather than time-bound projects
- Add a decision framework for where to place mediation
